data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1882 recorded a gross prior-year reserve deterioration (strengthening) of GBP 5.177m in 2018, driven primarily by adverse experience in third party liability (professional lines). Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 164.182m. The movement represents approximately a 3.15% adverse reestimation of opening reserves. Some other classes (e.g. Fire and other damage to property, Reinsurance Acceptances) showed releases which partially offset the deterioration in third party liability.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, comparative 2017 column). Prior year movement taken from Note 5 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (table totals are gross movements). Percent calculation uses opening gross claims outstanding. Gross written premiums for 2018 are negative due to adjustments to prior years' premiums; percentages are computed relative to the signed total (-1.88m). No specific named catastrophe events are mentioned in the report. Confidence is high for extracted numeric values as they are explicitly shown in the financial statements and notes.
